purpose: Map specialized community agent adapters to separately installed third-party skills, MCP servers and applications.
identity_policy: No listed vendor software/skill is an original IA-Gov agent; the community operator adapters are not official vendor agents.
installation_policy: No installation, API account creation, purchase, hosted data transfer or external service access is implied by GitHub registration.
connection_state_note: This records supported procedures, not live connectivity. A running Codex or Agency Agents client must verify each tool and permissions.
